title: Qualify closed canonical IR JSON and structural hashes after MSTEST0032 repair
commitMessage: feat: harden canonical IR JSON and qualify distinct structural hashes

contribution.summary: Observe three independent IR JSON boundary REDs, enforce a closed typed JSON field schema and duplicate-key rejection, bound exact numeral parsing and validate referenced restrictions, then qualify separate versioned structural-semantic and presentation SHA-256 digests with eleven adversarial tests and full locked regressions.
contribution.value: Closes the standalone typed Math IR model and canonical JSON transport work package with exactness-preserving constrained decode and explicit hash identities, without accepting unknown fields or implying generic CAS equivalence.
debtChanges: Only restriction references to symbols in their expression are verified at decode. A complete executable binder and global bound-scope declaration proof are not claimed because no binder node exists in the admitted IR subset.

Structural semantic SHA-256 is a versioned canonical tree identifier, not a proof of algebraic or alpha-equivalent mathematics; passive display labels are excluded while presentation hashes retain them.
No MathML/OpenMath adapter, generic CAS, remote consumer cutover or AURA adoption is implied by the completed local IR package.

Retry 0 failed before attempt allocation: a compile-time MSTEST0032 tautological assertion against constant IrCanonicalHashes.Scheme was removed from a staged boundary test. All remaining RED/GREEN oracles and target re-entry checks stay unchanged.
contribution.nextAction: Refine M2-W02-C01 result and operation-capability contracts against the qualified typed IR; qualify explicit exact/approximate/unsupported/budget outcomes without leaking provider or AURA host permissions.

achievements.achievement: Three prechange REDs independently prove that the codec accepts unknown JSON properties and unreferenced restriction symbols, and lacks separate versioned structural/presentation hashes.

Validate the closed JSON schema before materialization, refuse duplicate and unexpected properties, enforce exact numeral budgets and expression-referenced assumptions, and expose distinct versioned SHA-256 structural/presentation digests.

Three reds turn green; eleven adversarial oracles qualify strict envelope/node/assumption fields, malformed bits and scopes, bounded numerals, identity-aware restrictions and label-isolated hashes, with complete IR/quantities/foundation and package regressions.
The canonical codec boundary completes with closed-schema admission and versioned distinct SHA-256 contracts, without claiming general symbolic equivalence or an executable binder.

The exact mathematical IR JSON chunk completes with ten lossless v1 round-trip oracles, three independent boundary REDs and eleven adversarial GREENs; the qualified scope retains explicit future binder limits.

The full mathematical model work package closes with a bounded immutable typed IR, exact rational, quantity and symbol semantics, domain-safe assumptions, canonical JSON transport and qualified distinct structural/presentation digests.
